findings.finding: CED remains canonical semantic conditional evidence but is not the sole durable irreducible physical authority; durable authority is the source capsule plus replay bundle.
Normalized respondent data is a regenerable private cache after replay certification and is not permanently required merely for convenience.
Unary CEDs are insufficient for joint/intersectional meaning; sparse authorized conjunctions must be computed from reconstructible same-respondent incidence.
Legacy position_distribution is empirical-coordinate prevalence, not response-conditioned evidence and not ADP-009 actor-position authority.
Current uncertainty authority is descriptive support/weight qualification plus typed epistemic states; design-based sampling uncertainty is unavailable absent new governed design authority.
Empirical conditioning coordinates do not become generated-position requirements without separately accepted cross-ontology mapping authority.
Canonical conditional computation is selected only by explicit GOVERNED_CONDITIONAL_WORKLOAD_SPEC; fixed twelve-field exhaustive analysis cannot survive as hidden workload policy.
V553+ direct-DAG capability is transport/reuse of exact existing admitted objects, not recreation of missing upstream empirical meaning.
Evidence existence, V551 signed-evidence admission, V552 structural interpretation/pressure eligibility and runtime generated-position binding are separate gates.
Ordinary ResolvedStructuralContext should carry governed structural conditions and compact evidence qualifiers/refs, not raw P(response|condition) distributions as actor priors.

semantic_loss_findings: Unary-only retained conditionals lose interaction and Simpson-style joint meaning.
Deleting underpowered observed evidence erases historically real minority evidence even where use is denied.
Collapsing completion zero, no observation, missing authority and noncomparability creates false empirical claims.
Discarding either weighted or unweighted basis can conceal direction reversal and support differences.
Deleting respondent/source joint incidence in favor of finite current aggregates prevents exact future conjunction reconstruction.
Treating empirical coordinate labels as generated-position ontology launders population correlation into actor identity.
Treating direct-DAG capability as recreation hides missing upstream semantics.
Passing raw response distributions into actor-facing context invites P(response|condition) to become an illicit actor belief/response prior.
Using support thresholds as sampling confidence invents statistical authority not present in the retained design substrate.
Keeping the old twelve-field sweep as implicit workload policy would reintroduce unauthoritative computation behind a smaller artifact surface.
counterevidence: The legacy IAM shape itself need not remain canonical once exact predicate-preserving CED equivalence is proved.
Current recursive branches contain real conditional calculations, but their greedy/depth/support/top-two algorithm makes the tree a lossy diagnostic rather than joint source authority.
Position prevalence can have future governed value, but raw prevalence has no automatic ADP-009 or V558 membership authority.
A materialized CED can be safely rebuildable rather than permanently durable only if source/replay authority and serving reference closure are certified.
Diagnostic discovery of a strong unrequested interaction may be valuable, but association strength cannot self-promote it to canonical workload, structural meaning or runtime binding.
A V551/V552 numerical transformation may be deterministic after all authorities are fixed, but semantic interpretation and admission remain governed decisions.
